polityNote: Republic of China (Taiwan) province-level units — Taiwan Province, the ROC Fujian Province (Kinmen and Matsu) and the special municipalities — as unions of the 2017 OpenStreetMap townships/districts that geoBoundaries publishes (TWN ADM2, CC BY-SA 2.0). Taiwan Province 1945–1968 is answered by OpenHistoricalMap and is not drawn here; the scope starts on the day Taipei reached its present outline (1968-07-01) and ends the day before Taoyuan became a special municipality (2014-12-25), from which the county layout carried back by the fill takes over. Every change in the scope moved WHOLE townships (1968 annexation to Taipei, Xiaogang to Kaohsiung 1979) or whole counties/cities (2010 mergers), so each unit is a union of present-day townships. Kaohsiung City 1979–2010 is the 11 districts it had (Yancheng, Gushan, Zuoying, Nanzi, Sanmin, Xinxing, Qianjin, Lingya, Qianzhen, Qijin, Xiaogang), which keep those names as districts of today’s Kaohsiung. Pratas and Taiping Island carry no atom in this set.

events.what: Six townships annexed to Taipei special municipality (outline unchanged since)

sources.title: 臺北市 (zh.wikipedia, permanent revision)
sources.says: 1967-07-01 Taipei became a centrally administered municipality; 1968-07-01 the six townships Jingmei, Nangang, Muzha, Neihu (Taipei County) and Shilin, Beitou (Yangmingshan Administration) were annexed.

events.what: Kaohsiung City becomes a special municipality, absorbing Xiaogang township

sources.title: Kaohsiung (en.wikipedia, permanent revision)
sources.says: Kaohsiung City became a special municipality on 1 July 1979 with 11 districts; on 25 December 2010 it merged with Kaohsiung County.

sources.title: 小港區 (zh.wikipedia, permanent revision)
sources.says: When Kaohsiung City became a special municipality in 1979, Xiaogang township of Kaohsiung County was merged into it as a district.

events.what: New Taipei, Taichung, Tainan become special municipalities; Kaohsiung City and County merge

sources.title: Administrative divisions of Taiwan (en.wikipedia, permanent revision)
sources.says: Taipei became a special municipality in 1967 and Kaohsiung in 1979; New Taipei, Taichung and Tainan were upgraded and Kaohsiung City merged with Kaohsiung County effective 25 December 2010; Taoyuan followed on 25 December 2014.
